scripts.tsp:build: npm --prefix typespec run build && npm run sdk:build && npm run server:generate
scripts.server:check: php artisan spec:generate-server && git diff --exit-code app/Dto app/Http/Requests/Api app/Http/Controllers/Api routes/api.php
scripts.server:deterministic: git add -- app/Dto app/Http/Requests/Api app/Http/Controllers/Api routes/api.php && npm run server:generate && (git diff --exit-code -- app/Dto app/Http/Requests/Api app/Http/Controllers/Api routes/api.php; rc=$?; git reset -q HEAD -- app/Dto app/Http/Requests/Api app/Http/Controllers/Api routes/api.php; exit $rc)
scripts.spec: npm run tsp:build && npm run tsp:smoke && npm run server:deterministic && npm run typecheck
